sloka: युद्ध्यस्व यदि शूरो ऽसि रावणात्मज दुर्मते।वायुपुत्रं समासाद्य जीवन्न प्रतियास्यसि ।। ६.८६.३० ।।
transliteration: yuddhyasva yadi śūro 'si rāvaṇātmaja durmate।vāyuputraṁ samāsādya jīvanna pratiyāsyasi ।। 6.86.30 ।।

translations.english: Receiving those frightening weapons, Maruthi spoke these words overcome by anger.
